# Sanskarut Tech Team

> Sanskarut Tech Team is a premier digital engineering team specializing in custom web applications, SaaS platforms, high-performance websites, and advanced software engineering solutions.

## Core Expertise

- **SaaS Platform Engineering**: Highly scalable distributed architectures, multi-tenant databases, transactional integrity, and custom cloud gateways.
- **Custom Web Applications**: Built using modern frameworks (Next.js, React, Node.js, TypeScript) and responsive glassmorphic styling (Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion).
- **Technical SEO & Speed**: Standard implementation of semantic HTML structure, JSON-LD schemas (Organization, FAQPage), optimized static rendering, fast core web vitals, and explicit robot directives.
- **Systems Architecture**: Node processes, distributed API routing, database optimization (PostgreSQL, MongoDB), SMTP engines, and server maintenance.

- [Privacy & Security NDA Protocols](https://sanskarut.qzz.io/privacy): Complete confidentiality directives, Mutual NDA rules, HTTPS encryption layers, and repository protections.
